summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. In-Game Text Inspector & Untranslated Text Tracker with exportable JSON/CSV report and canonical vocabulary linking (teams, positions, stats, perks, playstyles, trophies).
2. True full-screen responsive stack navigation for Mobile (eliminating nested window-in-window in Player Development and career submenus, vertical paging, accessible close/back actions).
3. Redesigned Global Top Navigation Bar with enlarged clickable DrawStar logo (acting as return-to-main-menu button without redundant text) plus dedicated Back and Home buttons.
